title: NoteGPT Subtitle Downloader vs AudioTrackDown — Why Timestamps Matter
description: Compare NoteGPT Subtitle Downloader and AudioTrackDown. Learn why precise subtitle timestamps and multi-language support are essential.
content:
NoteGPT Subtitle Downloader: What is it?

NoteGPT has gained popularity as an AI-driven transcription and summary helper. However, when it comes to raw subtitle extraction, using general AI services has some drawbacks:

  • Altered Text: AI summarizes and edits the transcripts, which is bad if you need the exact original spoken text.
  • Timecode Stripping: Often outputs plain text summaries instead of exact SRT or WebVTT timecode intervals.
  • Usage Limitations: AI processing is expensive, so they restrict free usage heavily.

The AudioTrackDown Advantage

For raw, accurate subtitle extraction, AudioTrackDown offers a targeted, robust developer-grade tool:

  • 100% Exact Subtitles: We extract the exact original text and auto-captions as served by YouTube. No summarization or alterations.
  • Precise Timecodes: Fully compliant SRT, VTT, and JSON outputs with microsecond-accurate timings. Perfect for importing directly into Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, or CapCut.
  • No Restrictions: Free to use for subtitle extractions in 157+ languages, with no user account required.

Which Should You Choose?

If you want an AI-generated summary of a lecture, NoteGPT is a helpful tool. But if you need to download actual subtitle files (SRT or VTT) in multiple languages with perfect sync for video editing or translation, AudioTrackDown is the superior choice.
